name: stringedge1.k
model:
class StringEdgeCases1 {
  empty:String

  req empty = ""
  emptyLen:Int

  req emptyLen = empty.length

  req emptyLen = 0
  single:String

  req single = "X"
  singleLen:Int

  req singleLen = single.length

  req singleLen = 1
  singleChar:String

  req singleChar = single.charAt(0)

  req singleChar = "X"
  containsEmpty:Bool

  req containsEmpty = single.contains("")

  req containsEmpty = true
  startsWithEmpty:Bool

  req startsWithEmpty = single.startsWith("")

  req startsWithEmpty = true
}

main:StringEdgeCases1

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))

; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((StringEdgeCases1 (mk-StringEdgeCases1 (empty String)(emptyLen Int)(single String)(singleLen Int)(singleChar String)(containsEmpty Bool)(startsWithEmpty Bool)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-StringEdgeCases1 (sel-StringEdgeCases1 StringEdgeCases1))
  null))

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================

  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (str.len (empty (sel-StringEdgeCases1 (select heap 1))))))
